content: Stripe guarantees at-least-once webhook delivery, not exactly-once and not ordered delivery -- the same event can arrive multiple times (network timeout, non-2xx response, retry after outage) and events can arrive out of order (e.g. subscription.deleted before subscription.created). Production pattern: unique constraint on stripe event.id in a table as the dedup boundary (reject retried events before business logic runs, doubles as audit log); never trust the webhook payload as sole source of truth -- refetch/reconcile current state from Stripe inside the handler so processing is replay-safe and order-independent; use event.created timestamps or a version/lock for order-sensitive updates rather than assuming arrival order.
